verses.geez: አሌ፡ ሎሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ያኀሥሩክሙ፣፡ ወለክሙሰ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘያኀሥረክሙ፤ ዘሂ፡ ለክሙ፡ ዐለወ፡ አኮ፡ ኪያክሙ፡ ዘዐለወ።
verses.translation: Woe to them that afflict you; but no one makes you miserable: and he that deals perfidiously with you does not deal perfidiously: they that deal perfidiously shall be taken and given up, and as a moth on a garment, so shall they be spoiled.

translations.lxx: Woe to them that afflict you; but no one makes you miserable: and he that deals perfidiously with you does not deal perfidiously: they that deal perfidiously shall be taken and given up, and as a moth on a garment, so shall they be spoiled.
translations.kjv: Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.
translations.ron: Vai ţie, pustiitorule, care n-ai fost pustiit şi ţie, jefuitorule, care n-ai fost încă jefuit. Când vei sfârşi de pustiit, vei fi pustiit, când vei fi jefuit din destul, vei fi jefuit şi tu.

verses.geez: እግዚኦ፡ ተሠሀለነ፡ እስመ፡ ኪያከ፡ ተወከልነ።
verses.translation: Lord, have mercy upon us; for we have trusted in thee: the seed of the rebellious is gone to destruction, but our deliverance was in a time of affliction.

translations.lxx: Lord, have mercy upon us; for we have trusted in thee: the seed of the rebellious is gone to destruction, but our deliverance was in a time of affliction.
translations.kjv: O LORD, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
translations.ron: Doamne, miluieşte-ne, că întru Tine am nădăjduit, fii ajutorul nostru în fiecare dimineaţă şi izbăvirea noastră în vremuri de strâmtorare!

verses.geez: ወእምግርማ፡ ቃሉ፡ ደንገፁ፡ አሕዛብ፡ በፈሪሆትከ፡ ወተዘርዉ፡ አሕዛብ።
verses.translation: By reason of the terrible sound the nations were dismayed for fear of thee, and the heathen were scattered.

translations.lxx: By reason of the terrible sound the nations were dismayed for fear of thee, and the heathen were scattered.
translations.kjv: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.
translations.ron: La glasul tunetului Tău neamurile vor fugi; când Te ridici Tu, popoarele se vor risipi.

verses.geez: ወይእዜኒ፡ ናሁ፡ ይትጋብኡ፡ ምህርካክሙ፡ ንኡሱ፡ ወዓቢዩ፤ ከመ፡ ዘያስተጋብእ፡ አንበጣ፡ ከማሁ፡ ይትዌነይ፡ ብክሙ።
verses.translation: And now shall the spoils of your small and great be gathered: as if one should gather locusts, so shall they mock you.

translations.lxx: And now shall the spoils of your small and great be gathered: as if one should gather locusts, so shall they mock you.
translations.kjv: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.
translations.ron: Şi vor aduna prada voastră, cum adună lăcustele; arunca-se-vor asupra ei, cum se aruncă lăcustele.

verses.geez: ቅዱስ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘየኀድር፡ ውስተ፡ አርያም፡ ወመልአት፡ ጽዮን፡ ጽድቀ፡ ወርትዐ።
verses.translation: The God who dwells on high is holy: Sion is filled with judgment and righteousness.

translations.lxx: The God who dwells on high is holy: Sion is filled with judgment and righteousness.
translations.kjv: The LORD is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.
translations.ron: Domnul este mare, El locuieşte în înălţime; Sionul este plin de judecată şi de dreptate.

verses.geez: ወያገብእዎሙ፡ በሕግ፡ ውስተ፡ መዛግብተ፡ መድኃኒትነ።
verses.translation: They shall be delivered up to the law: our salvation is our treasure: there are wisdom and knowledge and piety toward the Lord; these are the treasures of righteousness.

translations.lxx: They shall be delivered up to the law: our salvation is our treasure: there are wisdom and knowledge and piety toward the Lord; these are the treasures of righteousness.
translations.kjv: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the LORD is his treasure.
translations.ron: Ocrotirea Domnului în aceste vremuri va fi pentru Sion comoară de fericire; înţelepciunea, ştiinţa şi temerea de Dumnezeu sunt avuţia lui.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ በግርማክሙ፡ ፈርሁክሙ፡ እለ፡ ቀዲሙ፡ ትፈርህዎሙ፡ አንትሙ፡ ወይርዕዱ፡ እምኔክሙ፤ ወይትፌነዉ፡ ሐዋርያት፡ እንዘ፡ መሪረ፡ ይበክዩ፡ ወይስእሉ፡ ሰላመ።
verses.translation: Behold now, these shall be terrified with fear of you: those whom ye feared shall cry out because of you: messengers shall be sent, bitterly weeping, entreating for peace.

translations.lxx: Behold now, these shall be terrified with fear of you: those whom ye feared shall cry out because of you: messengers shall be sent, bitterly weeping, entreating for peace.
translations.kjv: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.
translations.ron: Iată că locuitorii din Ariel strigă pe uliţe, solii pentru pace plâng amar.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ማሰነ፡ ፍኖቶሙ፡ ወኀለፈ፡ ግርማሆሙ፡ ለአሕዛብ፡ ወተሥዕረ፡ ኪዳኖሙ፡ ወኢትረስይዎሙ፡ ከመ፡ ዕደው።
verses.translation: For the ways of these shall be made desolate: the terror of the nations has been made to cease, and the covenant with these is taken away, and ye shall by no means deem them men.

translations.lxx: For the ways of these shall be made desolate: the terror of the nations has been made to cease, and the covenant with these is taken away, and ye shall by no means deem them men.
translations.kjv: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.
translations.ron: Drumurile sunt pustii, nici un trecător pe cale. El strică legământul, nesocoteşte cetăţile, nu mai ţine seamă de nimeni.

verses.geez: ላሐወት፡ ምድር፡ ወተኀፍረ፡ ሊባኖስ፣፡ ዖመ፡ ኮነ፡ ሳሮን።
verses.translation: The land mourns; Libanus is ashamed: Saron is become marshes; Galilee shall be laid bare, and Chermel.

translations.lxx: The land mourns; Libanus is ashamed: Saron is become marshes; Galilee shall be laid bare, and Chermel.
translations.kjv: The earth mourneth and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.
translations.ron: Ţara plânge şi tânjeşte, Libanul este tulburat şi ofilit. Şaronul a ajuns ca un pustiu, Basanul şi Carmelul îşi scutură frunzişul lor.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ ይእዜ፡ እትነሣእ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፣፡ ይእዜ፡ እሴባሕ፡ ወይእዜ፡ እትሌዐል፡ አነ።
verses.translation: Now will I arise, saith the Lord, now will I be glorified; now will I be exalted.

translations.lxx: Now will I arise, saith the Lord, now will I be glorified; now will I be exalted.
translations.kjv: Now will I rise, saith the LORD; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.
translations.ron: Acum Mă voi scula, zice Domnul, acum Mă voi ridica, acum Mă voi înălţa!

verses.geez: ይእዜ፡ ትሬእዩ፡ ወይእዜ፡ ታነክሩ፤ ይከውን፡ ከንቶ፡ ኃይለ፡ መነፈስክሙ፡ ወእሳት፡ ትበልዐክሙ።
verses.translation: Now shall ye see, now shall ye perceive; the strength of your breath shall be vain; fire shall devour you.

translations.lxx: Now shall ye see, now shall ye perceive; the strength of your breath shall be vain; fire shall devour you.
translations.kjv: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath, as fire, shall devour you.
translations.ron: Zămislit-aţi fin şi aţi născut paie, suflarea voastră e foc care vă va mistui,

verses.geez: ወይከውኑ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ከመ፡ ዋዕየ፡ ሦክ፡ ዘገዳም፡ ውዑያነ፡ ወግዱፋነ።
verses.translation: And the nations shall be burnt up; as a thorn in the field cast out and burnt up.

translations.lxx: And the nations shall be burnt up; as a thorn in the field cast out and burnt up.
translations.kjv: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
translations.ron: Popoarele vor fi prefăcute în cenuşă ca spinii tăiaţi şi mistuiţi de foc!

verses.geez: ወይሰምዑ፡ ዘገበርኩ፡ እለሂ፡ እምርኁቅ፣፡ ወእለሂ፡ እምቅሩብ፡ የአምሩ፡ ኃይልየ።
verses.translation: They that are afar off shall hear what I have done; they that draw nigh shall know my strength.

translations.lxx: They that are afar off shall hear what I have done; they that draw nigh shall know my strength.
translations.kjv: Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; and, ye that are near, acknowledge my might.
translations.ron: Voi cei de departe, auziţi ce am făcut, şi voi cei de aproape, cunoaşteţi puterea Mea!

verses.geez: ዐለዉኒ፡ እለ፡ ውስተ፡ ጽዮን፡ ወዐመፁኒ፤ ናሁ፡ ይእኅዞሙ፡ ረዓድ፡ ለኃጥኣን።
verses.translation: The sinners in Sion have departed; trembling shall seize the ungodly. Who will tell you that a fire is kindled? Who will tell you of the eternal place?

translations.lxx: The sinners in Sion have departed; trembling shall seize the ungodly. Who will tell you that a fire is kindled? Who will tell you of the eternal place?
translations.kjv: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?
translations.ron: Păcătoşii vor tremura în Sion şi pe cei fără de lege fierul îi va cuprinde: "Care din noi poate să îndure focul mistuitor, care din noi poate să stea pe jarul cel de veci?"

verses.geez: ዘየሐውር፡ በጽድቅ፡ ወዘይነብብ፡ ርቱዐ፣፡ ዘይጸልእ፡ ፍኖተ፡ ዓመፃ፣፡ ዘይጸልእ፡ ኃጢአተ፡ ወጽልሑተ፡ ወዘይመይጥ፡ እዴሁ፡ እምሕልያን፤ ዘይመይጥ፡ እዝኖ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይስማዕ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ነፍስ፡ ወይከድን፡ ዐይኖ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይርአይ፡ ግፍዓ።
verses.translation: He that walks in righteousness, speaking rightly, hating transgression and iniquity, and shaking his hands from gifts, stopping his ears that he should not hear the judgment of blood, shutting his eyes that he should not see injustice;

translations.lxx: He that walks in righteousness, speaking rightly, hating transgression and iniquity, and shaking his hands from gifts, stopping his ears that he should not hear the judgment of blood, shutting his eyes that he should not see injustice;
translations.kjv: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil;
translations.ron: Omul cel drept în calea sa şi cel ce grăieşte cuvinte de cinste, care dă la o parte câştigul cel nedrept, cel ce mâinile înapoi le trage şi mită nu primeşte, care-şi astupă urechile când aude fărădelegi şi îşi pune văl pe ochi ca să nu mai vadă răul,

verses.geez: ዘከመዝኬ፡ ይነብር፡ ውስተ፡ ልዑል፡ በአተ፡ ኰኵሕ፡ ጽኑዕ፤ ወይትወሀቦ፡ እክልሂ፡ ወማይሂ፡ በጽድቅ።
verses.translation: he shall dwell in a high cave of a strong rock: bread shall be given him, and his water shall be sure.

translations.lxx: he shall dwell in a high cave of a strong rock: bread shall be given him, and his water shall be sure.
translations.kjv: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.
translations.ron: Acela va locui pe înălţimi, Şi stâncile cele tari vor fi cetatea lui; pâine i se va da şi apa nu-i va lipsi.

verses.geez: ወትሬእይዎ፡ ለንጉሥ፡ ምስለ፡ ስብሐት፡ ወይሬእያ፡ አዕይንቲክሙ፡ ምድረ፡ ርኁቀ።
verses.translation: Ye shall see a king with glory: your eyes shall behold a land from afar.

translations.lxx: Ye shall see a king with glory: your eyes shall behold a land from afar.
translations.kjv: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.
translations.ron: Ochii tăi vor privi pe rege în toată frumuseţea lui şi o ţară îndepărtată vor vedea.

verses.geez: ወትትሐዘብ፡ ነፍስክሙ፡ ፍርሃተ።
verses.translation: Your soul shall meditate terror. Where are the scribes? where are the counsellors, where is he that numbers them that are growing up,

translations.lxx: Your soul shall meditate terror. Where are the scribes? where are the counsellors, where is he that numbers them that are growing up,
translations.kjv: Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?
translations.ron: Inima ta îşi va aduce aminte de aceste vremuri de groază, zicând: "Unde este scriitorul, unde este vistiernicul, unde este străjuitorul cel din turnuri?

verses.geez: ንኡሱ፡ ወዓቢዩ፡ ሕዝብ፡ እለ፡ ኢመከሩ፡ ወእለ፡ ኢያእመሩ፡ ነገረ፡ ዕሙቀ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይስምዑ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ዓማፅያን፣፡ ወዘኒ፡ ይሰምዕ፡ ከመ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ልበ።
verses.translation: even the small and great people? with whom he took not counsel, neither did he understand a people of deep speech, so that a despised people should not hear, and there is no understanding to him that hears.

translations.lxx: even the small and great people? with whom he took not counsel, neither did he understand a people of deep speech, so that a despised people should not hear, and there is no understanding to him that hears.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue, that thou canst not understand.
translations.ron: Atunci nu vei mai vedea pe poporul acesta îndrăzneţ, acest neam cu vorbe încâlcite, pe care nu-l înţelegem, care bâlbâie o limbă care nu se poate pricepe.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ ጽዮን፡ ሀገረ፡ መድኃኒትነ፣፡ ወትሬእዪ፡ በአዕይንትኪ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ ሀገር፡ ብዕልት፤ ወአብያቲሃኒ፡ ዘኢያንቀለቅል፡ ወዘኢይትሐወስ፡ መታክለ፡ ደብተራሃ፡ ለመዋዕለ፡ ዓለም፡ ወአሕባሊሃኒ፡ ዘኢይትበተክ።
verses.translation: Behold the city Sion, our refuge: thine eyes shall behold Jerusalem, a rich city, tabernacles which shall not be shaken, neither shall the pins of her tabernacle be moved for ever, neither shall her cords be at all broken:

translations.lxx: Behold the city Sion, our refuge: thine eyes shall behold Jerusalem, a rich city, tabernacles which shall not be shaken, neither shall the pins of her tabernacle be moved for ever, neither shall her cords be at all broken:
translations.kjv: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
translations.ron: Priveşte Sionul, cetatea sărbătorilor noastre; ochii tăi să vadă Ierusalimul, loc de linişte, cort bine înfipt, ai cărui ţăruşi nu se pot scoate, ale cărui frânghii nu se pot desface.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዓቢይ፡ ለክሙ፤ ወይከውን፡ ለብሔርክሙ፡ አፍላግ፡ ወሙኃዘ፡ ማይ፡ ርሒብ፡ ወስፉሕ፡ ኢተሐውር፡ እንከ፡ ዘንተ፡ ፍኖተ፣፡ አሕማርኒ፡ ኢየሐውራ።
verses.translation: for the name of the Lord is great to you: ye shall have a place, even rivers and wide and spacious channels: thou shalt not go this way, neither a vessel with oars go thereby.

translations.lxx: for the name of the Lord is great to you: ye shall have a place, even rivers and wide and spacious channels: thou shalt not go this way, neither a vessel with oars go thereby.
translations.kjv: But there the glorious LORD will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.
translations.ron: Domnul este pentru noi aici în toată slava Sa; El ţine loc pentru noi de fluvii, de largi canaluri, pe care nici o barcă cu vâsle nu trece, pe care nici o corabie mare nu merge.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ዓቢይ፡ ውእቱ፡ አምላኪየ፡ እግዚአብሔር፤ ወኢይትሄየየኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ መኰንንነ፡ ወእግዚአብሔር፡ አምላክነ፡ ወእግዚአብሔር፡ ንጉሥነ፤ ውእቱ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ያድኅነነ።
verses.translation: For my God is great: the Lord our judge shall not pass me by: the Lord is our prince, the Lord is our king; the Lord, he shall save us.

translations.lxx: For my God is great: the Lord our judge shall not pass me by: the Lord is our prince, the Lord is our king; the Lord, he shall save us.
translations.kjv: For the LORD is our judge, the LORD is our lawgiver, the LORD is our king; he will save us.
translations.ron: Domnul este Judecătorul nostru, Domnul este Căpetenia noastră, Domnul este Împăratul nostru, El ne va izbăvi!

verses.geez: ተበትከ፡ አሕባልኪ፡ እስመ፡ ኢረትዐ፤ ዓምድኪ፡ ጸነት፡ ወኢበጽሐ፡ ሠርዌኪ፤ ኢያነሥእ፡ ትእምርተ፡ እስከ፡ ይእኀዝዎ፡ ወይመሀርክዎ።
verses.translation: Thy cords are broken, for they had no strength: thy mast has given way, it shall not spread the sails, it shall not bear a signal, until it be given up for plunder; therefore shall many lame men take spoil.

translations.lxx: Thy cords are broken, for they had no strength: thy mast has given way, it shall not spread the sails, it shall not bear a signal, until it be given up for plunder; therefore shall many lame men take spoil.
translations.kjv: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.
translations.ron: Frânghiile tale sunt dezlegate, ele nu mai sprijină catargul, nici nu mai întind pânzele. Atunci se va împărţi o mare pradă şi şchiopii vor avea parte de ea.

verses.geez: ወኢይብል፡ ደከምኩ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ዘይነብር፡ ውስቴቶሙ፤ እስመ፡ ይትኀደግ፡ ሎሙ፡ ኃጣውኢሆሙ።
verses.translation: And the people dwelling among them shall by no means say, I am in pain: for their sin shall be forgiven them.

translations.lxx: And the people dwelling among them shall by no means say, I am in pain: for their sin shall be forgiven them.
translations.kjv: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.
translations.ron: Nimeni dintre locuitorii Sionului nu va zice: "Sunt bolnav!" Poporul care-l locuieşte va dobândi iertarea păcatelor.
